mutations.label: package: a gate with no mutation is named, not counted
mutations.only: ^(?:every catalogue entry still matches the source it mutates, exactly once|every shipped gate carries at least one mutation)$

mutations.label: package: a catalogue entry that matches nothing is named
mutations.only: ^(?:every catalogue entry still matches the source it mutates, exactly once)$

mutations.label: package: a real home path in a tracked file is named
mutations.only: ^(?:nothing tracked in this repository names a personal filesystem path|every catalogue entry still matches the source it mutates, exactly once)$

mutations.label: package: a cross-line mutation is checked against the file's line endings
mutations.only: ^(?:every catalogue entry still matches the source it mutates, exactly once|a mutation that matches across lines targets a file git checks out with LF)$

mutations.label: agents: a new shipped directory is admitted, never leaked past
mutations.only: ^(?:what ships is the plugin and nothing else|every catalogue entry still matches the source it mutates, exactly once)$

mutations.label: ci: a job that skips itself on a dispatch makes every release unreleasable, and something says so
mutations.only: no job in the release workflow is conditioned so a dispatched run skips it

mutations.label: ci: an upload of a dotfile without include-hidden-files uploads nothing and reports success
mutations.only: an artifact upload of a dotfile asks for hidden files

mutations.label: ci: a shard that resolves its own cache generation can compute a different partition
mutations.only: every mutation shard computes its slice from one snapshot

mutations.label: readme: a name counts only as the list names it, in backticks
mutations.only: ^the README names every skill and gate this plugin ships$
